label: Small tweaks for the native Zen Library. Each feature below toggles independently.
Turning it off unregisters everything and restores native behavior immediately, no restart needed (the urlbar provider, once loaded, stays until restart).

Lists the boards stored by the zen-easel mod in the native Zen Library, with search, open, rename and delete. Requires the zen-easel mod; without it the section shows an empty state. Toggling applies immediately, no restart needed.

Gathers images, video and audio from your Downloads folder, Zen Easel captures, Screenshots and optional extra folders (zen.library.media.user-dirs, semicolon-separated) into a masonry grid with type/location filters, previews and audio playback. Toggling applies immediately, no restart needed.
